$comment: Central LunaNav configuration. Backend reads this at startup and serves the public subset at GET /api/config. Edit here first when NASA publishes new challenge details. See docs/ADAPTATION_GUIDE.md.

mission.$comment: The mission this build is scoped to. See docs/MISSION.md and docs/SPECIFICATIONS.md. Hypothetical, not a flown mission.
mission.name: Polar Ice Scout
mission.label: 7-day solar-powered robotic mission
mission.objective: Investigate the lunar south-pole environment and support scientific exploration of potential water ice near permanently shadowed regions.

requirements.$comment: Phase 1 Task 3 thresholds. Measured over the whole mission window by the metric registry, served at GET /api/config and checked by POST /api/requirements. Hypothetical demonstration targets, not official NASA mission specifications - see docs/SPECIFICATIONS.md.
requirements.basis: Hypothetical demonstration requirements for the 7-day Polar Ice Scout scenario, not official NASA mission specifications.

coordinates.frame: Mean Earth / Polar Axis (ME), IAU planetocentric

jpl.$comment: Live NASA/JPL services. No API key required. Override URLs with LUNANAV_HORIZONS_URL / LUNANAV_TREK_URL (e.g. for a proxy).

lola_shade.label: LOLA colour shaded relief
lola_shade.credit: Elevation: NASA/GSFC LRO LOLA team. Tiles: NASA/JPL Moon Trek.

wac.label: LROC WAC mosaic
wac.credit: Imagery: NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University LROC. Tiles: NASA/JPL Moon Trek.

lola_dem.label: LOLA elevation (greyscale)
lola_dem.credit: Elevation: NASA/GSFC LRO LOLA team. Tiles: NASA/JPL Moon Trek.

imagery.$comment: All layer paths were confirmed against Moon Trek on 2026-10-30. If Trek renames one, LunaNav reports it instead of showing a blank Moon. 'relief_layer' supplies the 3D Moon's shape; its 8-bit tiles are for display only, never for calculations.
